description: U.S. Sen. Susan Collins joined law enforcement officers, firefighters and emergency responders Sunday morning at the Basilica of Saints Peter and Paul for Maine’s annual Blue Mass, continuing a years-long tradition of recognizing the men and women who routinely run toward danger when others are trying to escape it.
